title: VCFArrow 0.9.0
text: read_vcf() reads plain gzip-compressed VCF files (including large DiscoSnp-RAD output) VCFArrow S4 object. Variant information kept memory; genotypes written disk ‘Apache Arrow’ dataset chunks read lazily, datasets larger memory can processed. set_vcf_groups() assigns samples groups (populations); vcf_copy() makes independent copy; vcf_gc() deletes -disk data objects longer referenced. vcf_memory_estimate() estimates memory export needs, vcf_suggest_chunk_size() suggests chunk size read_vcf() available memory.

title: VCFArrow 0.9.0
text: Variant filters: vcf_filter_quality(), vcf_filter_pass(), vcf_filter_biallelic(), vcf_filter_indels(), vcf_filter_coverage(), vcf_filter_maf(), vcf_filter_hets(), vcf_filter_missingness(), vcf_filter_invariant(), vcf_filter_oneSNV() vcf_filter_multiSNV() (SNV blocks), , DiscoSnp-RAD data, vcf_filter_rank(), vcf_filter_rpt() vcf_filter_paralogs(). Sample filters subsets: vcf_filter_missing(), vcf_extract_samples(), vcf_extract_groups(), vcf_sub_SNVs() vcf_sub_SNVs_stratified(). vcf_filter_adr() corrects removes genotypes extreme allele depth ratio (ALT / (REF + ALT)): changed homozygous set missing. vcf_bind() merges objects different samples, matching variants CHROM, POS, REF ALT, "intersect" "union" mode, ingroup/outgroup mode (outgroup = TRUE) optional recovery previously filtered loci (recover_loci = TRUE). vcf_bind_sparse() deprecated alias vcf_bind(..., recover_loci = TRUE).

title: VCFArrow 0.9.0
text: vcf_stats() computes per-sample statistics (heterozygosity, missing data, depth) , optionally, Watterson’s theta nucleotide diversity per group (vcf_theta()), accumulated chunk chunk little memory. assess_vcf_missing_data() writes table plots missing data per sample, assess_vcf_coverage() plots read depth per sample (PDF, PNG SVG).

title: VCFArrow 0.9.0
text: write_vcf() writes plain gzip-compressed VCF files. Converters input formats population-genetic phylogenetic software: vcf2admixture(), vcf2apparent(), vcf2arlequin(), vcf2bayesass(), vcf2bayescan(), vcf2eigenstrat(), vcf2fasta(), vcf2fineradstructure(), vcf2genepop(), vcf2migrate(), vcf2nexus(), vcf2plink_bed(), vcf2plink_ped(), vcf2related(), vcf2smartsnp(), vcf2snapp(), vcf2snmf(), vcf2structure() vcf2treemix(); vcf2gt_long() writes long genotype table (CSV, feather Parquet) vcf2genlight() returns ‘adegenet’ genlight object.

title: VCFArrow 0.9.0
text: vcf_set_workers() runs per-chunk work reading, filtering, statistics, merging exporting background R processes. Results depend number workers. Performance-critical steps (VCF parsing, per-sample counts, theta pi, writers exported formats) implemented C++.
